title: Task instruction for Trading Comps EV/EBITDA and P/E specifies 'Summary Valuation' while ground truth uses 'Trading Comps' values
evidence: The prompt in problem.py explicitly instructs: 'In the Trading Comps sheet, calculate EV/EBITDA for FY24–FY26 using fixed Enterprise Value from Summary Valuation, then calculate P/E for FY24–FY26 using fixed Equity Value from Summary Valuation.' On the 'Summary Valuation' sheet, fixed Enterprise Value is at D5/D6 (= 397.5782) and fixed Equity Value is at E5/E6 (= 374.1643). However, in the ground truth workbook (gt_19_Transformer_golden.xlsx), the six cells 'Trading Comps'!E50:G51 instead reference the Trading Comps sheet's own Enterprise Value ($E$44 = 302.1632, matching 'Trading Comps'!E49:G49) and Equity Value ($E$46 = 278.7493): E50='=$E$44/IS!G35' (39.9981), F50='=$E$44/IS!H35' (20.9362), G50='=$E$44/IS!I35' (9.7879), E51='=$E$46/IS!G32' (104.8193), F51='=$E$46/IS!H32' (39.6644), and G51='=$E$46/IS!I32' (15.1823). Because the single verifier 'SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check' (weight: 1) requires 100% modification ratio (mod_ratio == 1.0) to award any points, following the prompt instruction verbatim produces output values [52.6285, 27.5472, 12.8786] and [140.6986, 53.2414, 20.3792], resulting in a modification score of 0.9780 (267/273 cells) and a total score of 0.0 across all runs.
confirmation: Verified in gt_19_Transformer_golden.xlsx: E50='=$E$44/IS!G35' and E51='=$E$46/IS!G32' reference Trading Comps values, not the Summary Valuation D6/E6 the prompt names, so the six cells are off by about 25-35%.
fix: Answer key aligned with the instruction: gt_19_Transformer_golden.xlsx 'Trading Comps'!E50:G50 changed from =$E$44/IS!G35..I35 to ='Summary Valuation'!$D$6/IS!G35..I35 and E51:G51 from =$E$46/IS!G32..I32 to ='Summary Valuation'!$E$6/IS!G32..I32, with cached values updated (E50 52.628, F50 27.547, G50 12.879, E51 140.699, F51 53.241, G51 20.379). No other cell changed and nothing references these cells. Local grade: new GT passes, the old Trading-Comps-based answer fails on the 6 cells.

title: Trading Comps instruction says to use EV and Equity Value from Summary Valuation, but the answer key uses different Trading Comps cells
evidence: The instruction says: "In the Trading Comps sheet, calculate EV/EBITDA for FY24–FY26 using fixed Enterprise Value from Summary Valuation, then calculate P/E for FY24–FY26 using fixed Equity Value from Summary Valuation." On the Summary Valuation sheet, Enterprise Value is D6 = 397.578 (=SUMPRODUCT of DCF EV) and Equity Value is E6 = 374.164. The GT formulas point elsewhere. Trading Comps E50:G50 = '=$E$44/IS!G35' etc., where Trading Comps E44 = 302.163 (=E42*E39, the comps-implied EV). E51:G51 = '=$E$46/IS!G32', where Trading Comps E46 = 278.749. An agent that follows the instruction literally gets FY24 EV/EBITDA = 397.58/7.554 = 52.63, while the GT has 39.998. Its FY24 P/E = 374.16/2.659 = 140.7, while the GT has 104.82. All six cells are off by about 25–35%, far beyond the verifier's tolerance. The single verifier (weight 1) is all-or-nothing: it returns 1.0 only if regression and modification ratios are both 1.0. So any agent that faithfully follows the written instruction scores 0 on the whole task.
confirmation: Same confirmed prompt-vs-key contradiction: Summary Valuation!D6=397.578 and E6=374.164, while golden E50:G51 divide Trading Comps E44=302.163 and E46=278.749.
fix: Answer key aligned with the instruction: gt_19_Transformer_golden.xlsx 'Trading Comps'!E50:G50 changed from =$E$44/IS!G35..I35 to ='Summary Valuation'!$D$6/IS!G35..I35 and E51:G51 from =$E$46/IS!G32..I32 to ='Summary Valuation'!$E$6/IS!G32..I32, with cached values updated (E50 52.628, F50 27.547, G50 12.879, E51 140.699, F51 53.241, G51 20.379). No other cell changed and nothing references these cells. Local grade: new GT passes, the old Trading-Comps-based answer fails on the 6 cells.

title: The GT P/E uses the equity value implied by EV/EBITDA, not the one implied by P/E, which the model itself feeds into the football field
evidence: Trading Comps has two equity values. E46 = 278.749 comes from the EV/EBITDA multiple (E44 less net debt). F46 = 227.297 comes from the P/E multiple (=F39*F42). The model's own Summary Valuation!D23 ('Trading Comps P/E' base) = 227.297, which is F46. Even so, the GT P/E row uses E46 ('=$E$46/IS!G32' → FY24 104.82). Using F46 gives 85.47. Neither choice is the Summary Valuation equity value (374.16) the prompt names. So a competent analyst has at least three defensible inputs, and the all-or-nothing grader accepts only one.
confirmation: Confirmed: golden P/E row uses E46 (278.75, the EV/EBITDA-implied equity value), while Summary Valuation!D23 'Trading Comps P/E' links F46 (227.30) and the prompt names Summary Valuation E6 (374.16). The key matches none of the obvious readings of the instruction.
fix: Answer key aligned with the instruction: gt_19_Transformer_golden.xlsx 'Trading Comps'!E50:G50 changed from =$E$44/IS!G35..I35 to ='Summary Valuation'!$D$6/IS!G35..I35 and E51:G51 from =$E$46/IS!G32..I32 to ='Summary Valuation'!$E$6/IS!G32..I32, with cached values updated (E50 52.628, F50 27.547, G50 12.879, E51 140.699, F51 53.241, G51 20.379). No other cell changed and nothing references these cells. Local grade: new GT passes, the old Trading-Comps-based answer fails on the 6 cells.
